BiblicalUsage: This rare verb occurs only in Genesis 32:24: 'there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.' It is the word for the struggle itself — the grappling, the dust-raising contest at the ford of Jabbok where Jacob wrestles through the night.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse, one night, and it changes Jacob’s name and his walk — and I believe the wrestling matters more than the winning, because Jacob holds on and will not let go without a blessing.
